test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Niki Poonacha is a professional ________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Niki Poonacha **is a professional tennis player.
 
• He has competed in the Davis Cup and the South Asian Games for India.
 
• In India, he is ranked 8 and is considered one of the best up-and-coming tennis players.
 
• Digvijay Pratap Singh, 21, came in second place in the national championship behind Niki Poonacha. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Satnam Singh, Amjyot Singh, Amritpal Singh, Anitha Pauldurai and Geethu Anna Jose **are the famous **basketball **players in India.
 
• **Squash** players **Dipika Pallikal Karthik, Joshna Chinnappa, and Saurav Ghosal **are among the best in India.
 
• Rajasthan's Vishal Singh Rathore is a **polo **player.
